name: unikit-improve
description: Refine an existing implementation plan with a second iteration. Re-analyzes the codebase for gaps, missing tasks, and wrong dependencies. Use after /unikit-plan or to improve a /unikit-fix plan, or when the user says "improve the plan", "what's wrong with the plan", or "update the plan from research". Optional +check flag validates refinements via a fresh-context subagent.
